question: 2026年8月每个项目的租金收缴率是多少？从高到低。

route.message: 可以查询；执行时会明确说明采用的指标口径。
disclosures: 租金收缴率按账期统计，等于同一账期实收租金除以应收租金，不按到账日混入往期回款。

attempts.sql:
WITH monthly_collection AS (
    SELECT
        p.property_id,
        p.property_name,
        rp.billing_month,
        SUM(rp.amount_paid) AS total_paid,
        SUM(rp.amount_due) AS total_due
    FROM rent_payments rp
    JOIN leases l ON rp.lease_id = l.lease_id
    JOIN units u ON l.unit_id = u.unit_id
    JOIN properties p ON u.property_id = p.property_id
    WHERE rp.billing_month = '2026-08-01'
    GROUP BY p.property_id, p.property_name, rp.billing_month
)
SELECT
    property_name,
    CASE
        WHEN total_due > 0 THEN ROUND(CAST(total_paid AS REAL) / total_due, 4)
        ELSE NULL
    END AS collection_rate
FROM monthly_collection
ORDER BY collection_rate DESC;
attempts.summary: 统计2026年8月（账期）各项目的租金收缴率，即该账期实收租金除以应收租金，结果按收缴率从高到低排序。
